metadata.summary: Jiten attempted to order a customized Multigrain Bagel but the order was not successfully placed due to an empty cart error.

messages.text: Hello Jiten, welcome to Manhattan Bagel. It's great to see you again. What would you like to order?
I like to order multigrain bagel with plain cream cheese, having tomato, onion, as in vegetable. Also, like to have American cheese cheese American cheese as extra cheese. Can I get this?
The Multigrain Bagel with plain cream cheese, tomato, onion, and American cheese. Let me get the options for your bagel choices...
I hope you are still with me!
Yeah. I'm still there. Tell me.

Let me get the options for your bagel choices... So, for the Multigrain Bagel, I can confirm that we have plain cream cheese, and we can definitely add tomato and onion as vegetables. For the extra cheese, American cheese is a great choice. Let me just confirm the details... Perfect, let me add that to your order...
I'll just update your order with the Multigrain Bagel, plain cream cheese, tomato, onion, and American cheese. Alright, let me get this order placed for you...
Your cart is empty. Please add items to your cart before placing an order.
Let me add the Multigrain Bagel with plain cream cheese, tomato, onion, and American cheese to your order.
